title: LLM 100T+ Parameter Model
summary: Next-gen dense or MoE models exceeding 100T parameters requiring new infra
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Next-gen dense or MoE models exceeding 100T parameters requiring new infra.

Working prototypes demonstrated. Engineering challenges remain before commercial deployment. Our research database tracks 55 independent sources on this technology.

671B MoE (37B active), 14.8T training tokens. Outperforms GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet on multiple benchmarks. $5.6M training cost vs ~$100M+ for comparable closed models. Multi-token prediction objective. Proves cost-efficient frontier LLM at scale.

Status

Attribute Value
Development Stage Prototype
Confidence Level Speculative
Confidence Score +0.18
Estimated Deployment 2026–2029
Horizon Near-Term (Now–2026)
Independent Sources Tracked 55

What This Enables

Advancement here directly benefits or unblocks:

  • 1MW+ Per Rack AI Cluster
  • Distributed Training (1000+ GPUs)
  • Mixture-of-Experts Architecture

Investment Exposure

No direct listed-stock exposure identified yet in our research database.
